standing_coverage.description: Materially affected centers and protected conditions represented in active or reliably recoverable context.

contradiction_tolerance.description: Ability to preserve unresolved difference without forced consensus or collapse.

semantic_resolution.description: Granularity at which distinctions remain usable for the action's stakes.

temporal_span.description: Ability to relate relevant history, current state, and future consequence.

provenance_retention.description: Traceability of statements, inferences, transformations, and corrections.

uncertainty_retention.description: Preservation of unknown, inferred, contested, and stale status.

routing_capacity.description: Ability to move context to a competent and authorized loop.

recovery_capacity.description: Ability to restore omitted or degraded context after overload or error.

privacy_capacity.description: Ability to preserve necessary meaning without unnecessary disclosure or inference.

participant_load_tolerance.description: Ability to sustain meaningful participation without cognitive, emotional, or administrative overload.

escalation_capacity.description: Ability to recognize local insufficiency and route to an outer loop with the missing competence.

stop_capacity.description: Ability to reduce authority or halt before acting on inadequate context.

note: Research profile only. No total score is recommended.
